intro: This 15 day online meditation course mixes prerecorded videos and daily live Zoom classes (1 hour each) with teachers from Rishikesh, India. You'll learn different types of meditation and how to do them right, why each meditation works, and how to add meditation to your daily life over 15 days.
During live classes, you can practice leading sessions for friends or family. Got questions? Ask the teachers directly in the Zoom classes.

issues: Unverified marketing stats on page not used: '★★★★★ (265 Ratings)', '4.8 Rating', '4500+ Students', '10+ Yoga Teachers', '10+ Lessons'.

Certification is from Himalayan Yoga Association (Rishikesh), not Bali Yoga School or Yoga Alliance.
Teacher bios on page are generic and shared across all 15-day online courses (Yogi Himanshu, Yogi Deepak, Yogi Pramod, Yogini Stuti) — names only extracted.
'Benefits of ...' list (Benefits of Meditation) not extracted — generic benefits copy including health/medical claims.
